name: Approval Request Assigned
description: Send a notification to a user indicating they have an approval request that they need to review.
subject: An approval request is awaiting your review
body:
Approval Request Assigned

Dear ${__recipient.name},

You have $__contentJson.batchSize approval #if($__contentJson.batchSize==1) request #else requests #end awaiting your review.

To review approval requests that are assigned to you, use the button below.

Review approval requests

Thank you,
The ${__global.productName} Team
